thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a billing spike credited to APAC reserved commitments this month but a chunk of usage is landing in projects with no owner tag (project=infra-unassigned). Anyone else seeing this?
aj: Yup, ran a quick check in BigQuery export — ~18% of reserved GPU usage for Feb shows label_owner=NULL. Looks like values are attributed to 'unassigned' rather than the dedicated commitments.
chris: Sounds like reservation->nodepool affinity drift after the apac nodepool rename we did two weeks ago. The reservation labels didn't follow.
sam: I ran the label-reconcile job this morning; it matched ~85% but left a tail of instances with legacy nodepool names (gpu-shared-legacy_*). Those are the ones hitting unassigned.
lee: If it's the rename, we shouldn't be updating billing reservations themselves. Need an idempotent mapping from old nodepool names -> current owner tag in the billing export.
maria: Proposal: 1) generate authoritative list of affected reservations+instances; 2) run a mapping job that backfills label_owner on exported rows for active VMs (dry-run first); 3) schedule low-risk reservations for reassignment/migration to rebalance APAC/EU commit usage; 4) finance backfills chargeback before invoice close.
ops-bot: reminder: next billing aggregation job runs 2026-03-31 00:00 UTC (this will be the last chance to backfill Feb adjustments).
aj: Quick question — if we reassign reservation associations to a different reservation to make usage count to the right commit, will that cause restarts?
chris: There are two paths: (A) change reservation association metadata (safe if instance types match and live-association supported), (B) recreate association by draining instances and reattaching. Option A is low-touch but not always available depending on cloud API. Option B is safe but needs window.
sam: I can compose a safe script that: snapshot PVs, `kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`, change association, then uncordon. Low-risk for stateless GPUs.
lee: I'll produce the list from billing_export.reservations: `SELECT reservation_id, region, sku, SUM(usage) as usage_tokens FROM billing.reservations WHERE month='2026-02' AND label_owner IS NULL GROUP BY reservation_id,region,sku;` — that should give CSV for finance.
maria: Pasting a snippet of the query I'll use as well: ```sql
-- detect untagged reservations
SELECT r.reservation_id, r.region, r.sku, COUNT(i.instance_id) AS instances, SUM(i.hours) AS hours
FROM billing.reservations r
LEFT JOIN billing.instance_labels i ON r.reservation_id = i.applied_reservation
WHERE r.month = '2026-02' AND i.label_owner IS NULL
GROUP BY r.reservation_id, r.region, r.sku;
```
aj: :thumbsup: I'll run that against prod export and push CSV to finance slack DM after I validate counts.
chris: Note: some workloads are latency-sensitive and pinned to dedicated pools (no-migrate). We should annotate those reservations as `no-migrate` so automation skips them.
maria: Timeline suggestion: Today - generate lists + CSV. Tomorrow morning - mapping job dry-run (no writes). Tue morning - perform controlled reassignments for low-risk reservations. Wed - finance re-runs allocation and finalizes chargeback.
sam: I'll own the mapping job and the drain/reassign script. Plan to have dry-run logs by EOD.
aj: @emma (finance) — can you confirm whether backfilling Feb invoice is possible if we provide updated tags+CSV?
emma: emma: yes, we can backfill if we get the CSV and tag mapping before the aggregation cutoff. We'll mark adjustments as one-off corrections on Feb billing.
maria: Action items: sam open PR with mapping script + dry-run output, chris prepare `no-migrate` reservations list, aj run query & upload CSV to finance, lee run the grouping query and confirm row counts, emma stand by for adjust.
deploy-bot: mapping-job v2 scheduled (dry-run) — 22:45 UTC tonight.
ops-bot: FYI — please add `resv-affinity` label to tickets so we can tie changes to the reservations audit trail.
maria: Great. If nobody objects, we'll proceed with that cadence. Ping here when CSVs are uploaded.
